code_layout: SSSS S EEE  = subsystem(4) severity(1) fault index(3)

8.label: pause / actionable - the user can retry or resume

03004000.subsystem: printer core - motion, homing, bed and nozzle temperature

03004001.subsystem: printer core - motion, homing, bed and nozzle temperature

text.en: The printer timed out waiting for the nozzle to cool down before homing.
text.zh-cn: 工具头降温超时。

03004002.subsystem: printer core - motion, homing, bed and nozzle temperature

text.en: Mesh bed leveling failed.
text.zh-cn: 热床调平失败。

03004003.subsystem: printer core - motion, homing, bed and nozzle temperature

text.en: Nozzle temperature malfunction.

03004004.subsystem: printer core - motion, homing, bed and nozzle temperature

text.en: Heatbed temperature malfunction.
text.zh-cn: 热床温度失控

03004005.subsystem: printer core - motion, homing, bed and nozzle temperature

text.en: The heatbreak fan speed is abnormal.
text.zh-cn: 热端风扇转速异常。

03004006.subsystem: printer core - motion, homing, bed and nozzle temperature

text.en: The nozzle is clogged.
text.zh-cn: 热端堵头。

03004008.subsystem: printer core - motion, homing, bed and nozzle temperature

text.en: The AMS failed to change filament.
text.zh-cn: AMS换料失败。

03004009.subsystem: printer core - motion, homing, bed and nozzle temperature

text.en: Homing XY axis failed.
text.zh-cn: XY回零失败。

0300400A.subsystem: printer core - motion, homing, bed and nozzle temperature

text.en: Mechanical resonance mode identification failed.
text.zh-cn: 机械模态识别失败。

0300400B.subsystem: printer core - motion, homing, bed and nozzle temperature

text.en: Internal communication exception.
text.zh-cn: 内部通讯异常。

0300400C.subsystem: printer core - motion, homing, bed and nozzle temperature

text.en: Printing was cancelled.
text.zh-cn: 打印已取消。

0300400D.subsystem: printer core - motion, homing, bed and nozzle temperature

text.en: Resume failed after power loss.
text.zh-cn: 断电续打失败。

03008000.subsystem: printer core - motion, homing, bed and nozzle temperature
03008000.severity: pause / actionable - the user can retry or resume

text.en: Printing was paused for unknown reason. You can click resume icon to resume the print job.
text.zh-cn: 未知原因暂停。你可以点击恢复图标来恢复打印。

03008001.subsystem: printer core - motion, homing, bed and nozzle temperature
03008001.severity: pause / actionable - the user can retry or resume

text.en: Printing was paused by the user. You can click resume icon to resume the print job.
text.zh-cn: 用户暂停。你可以点击恢复图标来恢复打印。

03008002.subsystem: printer core - motion, homing, bed and nozzle temperature
03008002.severity: pause / actionable - the user can retry or resume

text.en: Obvious defects were detected in the first layer. If the defects are acceptable, click resume icon to resume the print job.
text.zh-cn: 首层检测器已暂停打印任务。如果可接受当前瑕疵，可点击恢复图标恢复打印。

03008003.subsystem: printer core - motion, homing, bed and nozzle temperature
03008003.severity: pause / actionable - the user can retry or resume

text.en: A possible printing failure was detected. If the defects are acceptable, click resume icon to resume the print job.
text.zh-cn: 打印故障检测器已暂停打印任务。如果可接受当前瑕疵，可点击恢复图标恢复打印。

03008004.subsystem: printer core - motion, homing, bed and nozzle temperature
03008004.severity: pause / actionable - the user can retry or resume

text.en: The filament ran out. Please load new filament in Temperature/Axis and click resume icon to resume the print job.
text.zh-cn: 打印已暂停。打印材料耗尽。可在“温度/轴移动”中加载新料后，点击恢复图标恢复打印。

03008005.subsystem: printer core - motion, homing, bed and nozzle temperature
03008005.severity: pause / actionable - the user can retry or resume

text.en: Printing was paused because the front cover of tool head fell. Please mount it back and click resume icon to resume the print job.
text.zh-cn: 打印已暂停。检测到前盖掉落。可在装上前盖后，点击恢复图标恢复打印。

03008006.subsystem: printer core - motion, homing, bed and nozzle temperature
03008006.severity: pause / actionable - the user can retry or resume

text.en: The build plate is not the same as that is in G-code. Please change to other plate and click resume icon to resume the print job.
text.zh-cn: 检测到热床与G-code配置不一致。请更换其他热床后，点击恢复图标恢复打印。

03008007.subsystem: printer core - motion, homing, bed and nozzle temperature
03008007.severity: pause / actionable - the user can retry or resume

text.en: There is unfinished print job when power off, click resume icon to resume the print job.
text.zh-cn: 检测到断电时有未完成的打印任务，可点击恢复图标恢复打印。

03008008.subsystem: printer core - motion, homing, bed and nozzle temperature
03008008.severity: pause / actionable - the user can retry or resume

text.en: Nozzle temperature malfunction.
text.zh-cn: 喷嘴温控故障。

03008009.subsystem: printer core - motion, homing, bed and nozzle temperature
03008009.severity: pause / actionable - the user can retry or resume

text.en: Heatbed temperature malfunction.
text.zh-cn: 热床温控故障。

text.en: Failed to connect to Bambu Cloud. Please check your network connection.
text.zh-cn: 无法连接服务器，请检查网络连接。

text.en: Unable to parse the received print job. Please update the firmware to the latest version and try again.
text.zh-cn: 无法解析收到的打印指令，请更新固件到最新版本后重试。

text.en: There was a problem parsing gcode.3mf. Please resend the printing job.
text.zh-cn: 解析gcode.3mf遇到问题，请重新发送打印。

text.en: Printing jobs are not allowed to be sent while printing.
text.zh-cn: 已经在打印过程，不允许启动新的打印

text.en: Print jobs are not allowed to be sent while updating firmware.
text.zh-cn: 不允许在固件更新过程中发送打印任务。

text.en: There is not enough free storage space for the print job. Restoring to factory settings can release available space.
text.zh-cn: 内部存储空间不足，可恢复出厂设置以释放所有可用空间。

text.en: Printing jobs are not allowed to be send while force upgrading or repair upgrading is required.
text.zh-cn: 需要修复升级和强制升级，不允许打印。

text.en: Starting printing failed. please power cycle the printer and resend the print job.
text.zh-cn: 启动打印失败，请重启机器并重新发送打印。

text.en: Print jobs are not allowed to be sent while updating logs.
text.zh-cn: 不允许在日志上传过程中发送打印任务。

07008001.severity: pause / actionable - the user can retry or resume

text.en: Failed to cut the filament. Please check the cutter. After troubleshooting, click the retry button.
text.zh-cn: 检测到切料失败，请检查切刀，排除异常后点击“重试”按钮。

text.en: The cutter is stuck. Please pull out the cutter handle and click the retry button.

text.en: Failed to pull out the filament from the extruder. Please check whether the nozzle is clogged or whether the the filament is broken inside extruder. After troubleshooting, click the retry button.
